method: Independent MediaPipe detection; 10fps sampling; longest contiguous detected segment; first-wrist trajectory normalization; 24-step resampling; balanced SVM C=1 fixed before training. All accepted source clips are training data.
evaluation: No independent signer/session evaluation possible from supplied metadata. No accuracy estimate is reported. Source labels and sampled motion content need further expert verification; fresh webcam J/Z/background clips must be kept out of fitting for evaluation.
motion_ui_change: Only experimental-result wording changed in motion.js; static app script unchanged.
